$comment: Bare launch profile for the Raw Claude tab and, through `rendered`, the Falcon-hosted Rendered Bare tab (P5). Read by src-tauri/src/bare/ at every bare spawn and by Falcon (src-falcon/src/claude.rs bare_spawn) and the sidecar at every hosted one. Placeholders: {{root}} = the Vidar install root, {{home}} = this install's agent home (%LOCALAPPDATA%\Vidar\homes\<install-root-key>, src-tauri/src/bare/home_path.rs), {{payload}} = this folder's `payload` file, or for a row naming rune sets the payload built from `setsPayload` into {{home}}\layer\payload-<hash12>.md (src-tauri/src/bare/layer.rs), all absolute at spawn. Plugins, `--allowedTools` and `--permission-mode` are not here: they come from the session's Rune Vault (stock runes vidar-app, gate, drive-allow, mode-auto; src-tauri/src/bare/claude_line.rs), so `plugins` stays empty. `assets` is what tools/sandbox/check-zip.ps1 requires in the release zip.

rendered.$comment: The Falcon-hosted Rendered Bare tab. Falcon builds the env from the allowlist plus `overlay` above plus this `overlay`; `plugins` stays empty (the sidecar throws without the block): a vault's plugin runes reach the sidecar by name through Falcon (`plugin_names`, admitted as {{root}}\plugins\<name>), never vidar.json pluginDirs. CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS keeps the gate's hooks module on in a cold config dir.
